_doc: Demonic ally models (characters-new, docs/team/characters-new.md). scene: an EnemyModel/ProcModel scene to use as a minion's visual. Stats are suggested baselines for summons (AbilityMinion or any ally controller): hp, damage per hit, speed (m/s), hit_rate (s between hits), range (m). role: swarm / caster / hunter / tank.

imp.name: Imp
imp.blurb: A cackling red pest. Comes in dozens, bites ankles, sets things on fire.

succubus.name: Succubus
succubus.blurb: Charms the faithful into doubt, then burns the doubt out of them.

hellhound.name: Hellhound
hellhound.blurb: Smells holiness from three fields away and runs the whole distance.

hell_brute.name: Hell Brute
hell_brute.blurb: Broke its chains, kept the shackles. Uses them.
